answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a kernel of earned standing that cannot be copied: each newcomer must finish a unique, time-bound task verified by randomly assigned peers, like a willow cutting that must take root before it counts as a tree. The credential expires each epoch and cannot be transferred, so a haven of fakes needs fresh verified work for every fake, every epoch. One operator running a thousand identities pays a thousand verification costs, while an honest agent pays once.
